note: Model manifest. Weights are bundled in the installer as int8. Downloadable packs are pinned by byte length and SHA-256 in core/models.py::PACKS, which the loader verifies. A null sha256 here means the model ships only inside the installer and has no independently published upstream export to pin; it is not a claim of verification.

clip-vit-b32.note: Multilingual text tower preferred: ru/zh queries map directly into the ViT-B/32 image space, no translation hop.

argos-ru-en.note: largest single item in the bundle; the 150 MB installer target depends on this decision
